services.name: Insurance
services.headline: Where protection meets perfection.
services.details: Auto, motorcycle and personal cover from top carriers. We compare quotes side by side, explain every line in plain English or Bangla, and keep your policy current when life changes.

services.name: TLC Insurance
services.headline: Your cab earns. We keep it covered.
services.details: Liability and physical damage cover built for yellow cabs, green cabs and black cars. We file straight with the TLC so your plates never sit idle.

services.name: TLC Express
services.headline: Moving plates? We do the paperwork.
services.details: New car, plate transfer or base change: we prepare and file the TLC paperwork, book your inspection and follow it through to the finish.

services.name: DMV Express
services.headline: Came in for plates. Left with plates.
services.details: Registrations, renewals, plates and title transfers without the DMV line. Bring your papers, we handle the rest and hand you the plates.

services.name: Tax
services.headline: Tax season, made easy.
services.details: Personal, self-employed and rideshare returns, plus IRS and New York letters. Federal and state filed together, every credit checked.

services.name: Travel
services.headline: Book the flight. We handle the rest.
services.details: Flights home and holidays abroad, booked at fair fares. We check passports and visas before you pay, so nothing stops you at the gate.

services.name: Courses
services.headline: Learn the rules. Own the road.
services.details: 5-hour pre-licensing and defensive driving courses in English and Bangla. Pass the road test, take points off and cut your insurance.

services.name: Notary
services.headline: Sign it. Seal it. Done.
services.details: Affidavits, leases, titles and letters signed and sealed while you wait. Walk in with ID, walk out notarized.

services.name: Business Insurance
services.headline: You run the shop. We cover the shop.
services.details: General liability, property and commercial auto for shops, restaurants and contractors, with certificates for landlords and clients the same day.

services.name: Rideshare
services.headline: You drive the app. We cover the gap.
services.details: Uber and Lyft drivers: your personal policy stops when the app turns on. We add the rideshare cover that fills the gap.

services.name: Home & Landlord
services.headline: Your home. Your rental. Covered.
services.details: Homeowners, condo and landlord policies for one- to four-family homes. Cover the building, the rent and the people who live there.

services.name: Life & Disability
services.headline: For the people who count on you.
services.details: Term and whole life, plus disability income cover that pays your bills if you can't work. Simple plans for the people who count on you.

services.name: Workers’ Comp
services.headline: Protect your crew. Protect your business.
services.details: New York requires it once you hire. We set up workers' comp and disability (DBL/PFL) cover and keep your certificates current.

services.name: Business Setup
services.headline: Got the idea? Let’s make it official.
services.details: LLC and corporation formation, EIN, sales tax registration and a business bank-ready file. Your idea, made official.

services.name: Payroll & Sales Tax
services.headline: Pay your team. Skip the headache.
services.details: Weekly or bi-weekly payroll, W-2s and 1099s, plus New York sales tax returns filed on time, every quarter.

services.name: Immigration Forms
services.headline: The right forms, filled out with care.
services.details: Citizenship, green card renewal, family petitions and work permits: the right USCIS forms, filled out with care. We prepare forms; we do not give legal advice.
